items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: Bill Russell is identified only as the interviewer ('This is Bill Russell, interviewing George Gayno'). The interviewee addresses him as 'Bill' but provides no information about a personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: This is Bill Russell, interviewing George Gayno at 600 Charter Street, and the date is June the 10th, 1960. Okay, can you tell us where you were born and just the exact date?
Yes, Bill, I was born on the 25th day of May 1907 in the Creole downtown section of New Orleans.
Can you tell us about, did anyone in your family play? Your father, mother, anyone play any music?

items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Him and I got to be good friends.

ctx.x: Did you get along with him all that?

Yeah, I got along with him fine. He used to have a white boy who comes to the house every day. He's a great writer. Him and I got to be good friends. His name is Charles Edward Smith. Yeah, I can say that. Boy, he was crazy about jelly. He was a man. He was a man. And Mabel could cook all kind of Creole gumbo and everything. We had us a ball every day up there. I got a manuscript he gave me with a number. I was trying to figure, Mr. Russell, when you said finger breaker, I've got that manuscript jelly. Give it to…
Yeah, I don't have the record here anymore. I'll bring it down to Missouri. You sure you didn't have it in that pile that we picked out the other night?

items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: That Bill Russell liked it so well. Him and his niece made a copy for me on a violin.

ctx.x: I bet it was. That was in the 20s. Oh, yeah, that's what it is.

But it's 30, yeah. Wow. He the prettiest of all the numbers I've ever written. I wrote it for my daughter when she died. I wrote it in Spanish. When she died? She died. She pulled me down. That Bill Russell liked it so well. Him and his niece made a copy for me on a violin. Yeah. Two violins together. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. 된
